remarks: Experience elevated living in this impeccably maintained 8th-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence offering stunning west-facing sunset views and refined finishes throughout. This sunlit home features an elegant open layout with crown molding, rich wood-style flooring, and a beautifully renovated kitchen complete with shaker cabinetry, quartz-style counters, subway tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. New kitchen and bedroom windows enhance energy efficiency and natural light, while custom Hunter Douglas window treatments add a touch of timeless sophistication. The spacious bedroom is a true retreat, featuring a custom closet with built-ins for optimal organization, while the updated bath boasts modern tilework and fixtures. Thoughtfully designed for comfort and functionality, the unit also offers a sizable coat closet and two deep hallway storage closets, providing exceptional in-unit storage. Step onto your private balcony to take in sweeping skyline vistas-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This luxury building offers an array of resort-style amenities including an outdoor pool, fitness center, reserved parking, storage locker, community room, children's playground, and a secured entrance gatehouse. HOA includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, and basic cable. Unbeatable location just steps to Tully Health Center, close to Downtown Stamford, I-95, CT-15, public transit, shopping, dining, and more-schedule your private tour today!
